meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分叉代码升级到上游版本并保留自定义修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护上游项目的分叉,想在不丢失自定义改动的前提下完成升级。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your fork to upstream while keeping your custom changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork and want to upgrade without losing your custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先扫描你的 NanoClaw fork，把自定义改动提取成一份可重放的迁移指南（markdown），然后在干净的 upstream 版本上按指南逐条重新应用，从而完成升级，不用 git merge。
howto.when: 当你想把 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游版本，或想生成／更新迁移指南时触发；若指南已存在，它会问你是直接升级还是先更新指南。

say.text: 帮我把这个 NanoClaw fork 升级到上游最新版
say.note: 先提取自定义，再在干净 upstream 上重放

say.text: 生成一份迁移指南，记录我对 NanoClaw 的自定义改动
我改过 add-telegram 这个技能，升级时别丢掉
say.note: 会单独分析该技能被改动的文件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans your NanoClaw fork, extracts your customizations into a replayable migration guide (markdown), then reapplies them on a clean upstream checkout to upgrade — no git merge.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to upgrade your NanoClaw fork to upstream, or to build/update the migration guide. If a guide already exists, it asks whether to skip straight to upgrade or update the guide first.

say_en.text: Upgrade this NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream
say_en.note: Extracts customizations, then reapplies them on clean upstream

say_en.text: Generate a migration guide for my NanoClaw customizations
I modified the add-telegram skill, don't lose it on upgrade
say_en.note: Analyzes that skill's changed files separately
